Name: CP Butter Churn
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Its a custom big craft able machine that churns butter but I haven't added a way for you to craft the machine only to buy. I may update this if you wanna be able to craft it.

Here is a butter churn machine and artisan goods drawn by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673?tab=about+me]Aimon111[/url] and also so their help with this mod!

5/14/24 Star quality milk produces star quality butter.

Comes with 5 artisan goods that can be crafter from the butter churn :
[list=1]
[*]Butter
[*]Large Butter
[*]Goat Butter
[*]Large Goat Butter
[*]Iridium Butter
[/list]4/28/24 Got permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/206031309]i24KittyKat[/url] to add these butters. Make sure to download this mod in order to make these [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22413?tab=files&file_id=93491]butters[/url]. They also come in large sizes.
﻿6. Void Butterm 
﻿7. Blue Butter
﻿8. Gold Butter﻿
4/28/24 Added a new way to get iridium milk, once you reach level 9 in mining you unlocked iridium milk (0g) but its worth it once you churn it into butter. Located in crafting section.

It takes 300 minutes for each of these items to craft. 

You can buy the butter churn from Marnie's for 1500. -5/14/24

Working on making an AT version with different colors of the butter churn.

This only works with 1.6 stardew valley update. Only need to download content patcher and have the latest smapi for this mod to work.

Enjoy!
